settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Defaults come from comfytv.properties in the ComfyTV directory. Values saved here are stored in the database and take precedence.

enable-v2.label: Enable ComfyTV V2 nodes (experimental)
enable-v2.desc: EXPERIMENTAL — expect rough edges. Renders migrated stages with the new content-first V2 shells. Requires ComfyUI's own Node 2.0 (Vue nodes) setting to be enabled first. Refresh the page after changing.

enable-db-backup.label: Automatic backup on startup
enable-db-backup.desc: Back up the ComfyTV data directory (database + workflows) every time the server starts, before any migration runs.

db-backup-max-count.label: Max backups to keep
db-backup-max-count.desc: When the number of snapshots exceeds this, the oldest ones are deleted.

db-backup-path.label: Backup location
db-backup-path.desc: Leave empty to use the db-backup folder inside the ComfyTV directory. Snapshots are timestamped folders like 20260805-093000/comfytv.

enable-mcp.label: Enable MCP server
enable-mcp.desc: Expose the ComfyTV MCP endpoint (/comfytv/mcp) so agents can read and drive the canvas. Off by default.

enable-bot.label: Enable ComfyTV Bot
enable-bot.desc: Show the embedded bot sidebar and its chat API. Requires the MCP server to be enabled.

bot-model-claude-code.label: Claude Code model
bot-model-claude-code.desc: Model passed to claude --model for bot turns. Accepts an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or a full model id. Blank = the CLI's own default.

bot-model-codex.label: Codex model
bot-model-codex.desc: Model passed to codex -m for bot turns. Blank = the CLI's own default.

bot-model-qwen-code.label: Qwen Code model
bot-model-qwen-code.desc: Model passed to qwen -m for bot turns. Blank = the model selected in qwen's own settings.

bot-model-local-llm.label: Local LLM model
bot-model-local-llm.desc: Model id on the local endpoint. Blank = the first model the endpoint reports.

bot-local-llm-url.label: Local LLM endpoint
bot-local-llm-url.desc: OpenAI-compatible base URL of a local model server (LM Studio, llama.cpp llama-server, vLLM, Ollama…). The Local LLM provider stays unavailable until this is set. Keyless local endpoints only — no API keys are ever stored.

bot-enable-comfy-mcp.label: Mount comfy-mcp
bot-enable-comfy-mcp.desc: Also mount the official comfy-mcp server (read-only tool set: node catalog, workflow validation, model/template search) in bot sessions. Claude Code and Qwen Code only — Codex and Local LLM stay comfytv-only.

bot-comfy-mcp-command.label: comfy-mcp command
bot-comfy-mcp-command.desc: Command that launches the comfy-mcp stdio server. Blank = find comfy-mcp on PATH.

enable-skills.label: Enable Agent Skills
enable-skills.desc: Serve installed skills to agents over MCP (skill tool + prompts) and to the embedded bot.

scene3d.noDurationToRecord: Nothing to record: add a camera preset, an animated character, or set a frame count.
scene3d.failedToInit: Failed to initialize the 3D scene editor.
scene3d.lightGizmoHint: Lights use dedicated handles: orbit rings for directional, position/target arrows for point and spot.
scene3d.failedToLoadModelAsset: Failed to load the 3D model asset.
scene3d.lookThroughGizmoHint: Exit the camera view to move this camera — you're looking through it.
scene3d.cameraPresetGizmoHint: This camera follows a preset path — dragging (move) adjusts the path offset; rotation is baked (tune with yaw/roll).

modelLoader.empty: No 3D models in input/3d yet — upload one to get started.

modelBinder.noModel: Pick or upload a model above first
modelBinder.pickHint: Click the model to select a part, then click a material to bind it

lineArt.noInputModel: Wire in a 3D model to render line art
lineArt.orbitHint: Orbit to frame the view — the render uses this camera

meshOps.runToGenerate: Set parameters, then Run to generate
meshOps.needTwoModels: Connect two models (A and B) to combine
meshOps.placeThenRun: Pick A or B, drag the gizmo to place it, then Run

splitPart.noInputImage: Connect an image to annotate parts
splitPart.hint: Click to add points to the active part (right-click = exclude); drag with Box to mark a part per box. Or leave empty and type a concept for the text workflow.

loaderDrop.assetTypeMismatch: This node loads {expected}, but the dropped asset is {actual}.

fxChain.title: FX Chain
fxChain.empty: Chain FX nodes along the video wire into this node

fx.chainMode: Adjust freely — an FX Chain node downstream renders once
fx.makeProxyHint: Large source — generate a lightweight proxy for smooth preview (Run still uses the original)
fx.needsTwoInputs: Wire two videos into A and B
fx.needsAudioOrVideo: Wire an audio or video input
fx.previewNote: Preview is approximate — Run renders precisely
fx.curveHint: Click to add · drag to move · right-click deletes
fx.detectHint: Run scans for hard cuts and outputs one thumbnail per scene
fx.sceneClipsHint: Run splits the video at each cut into per-scene clips — wire the clips output into a Video Picker
fx.sceneClipPickHint: Click a clip to select it — re-run and the clips output becomes that clip
fx.eqHint: Double-click adds a band · drag moves · wheel = Q · double-click a dot removes
fx.noLuts: No LUTs yet — upload a .cube file
fx.lutPreviewUnavailable: Live preview supports .cube and .3dl only — this LUT is applied on run
fx.dragHint: Drag the frame to move · wheel to scale
fx.rotoHint: Click adds a point · drag moves · double-click a point removes it
fx.trackHint: Click the frame to set the track point
fx.echoHint: Layered frame echoes with feedback trails.
fx.needsRetimeMap: Map mode needs a grayscale retime image
fx.expressionHint: Vars: t, frame, duration, fps. Fns: noise, fbm, turbulence, smoothstep, remap, mix, hash, random, sin/cos…
fx.stab360Hint: Two-pass: analyzes equirect yaw/pitch motion, smooths the camera path, then re-renders.
fx.stmapGenHint: 16-bit STMap for the undistort → comp → redistort workflow. Feed it into the STMap node.

afx.needsSrcAndIr: Wire a source audio and an IR audio
afx.sweepHint: Generates a Farina ESS sweep — play it in a room, record the response, then use Deconvolve
afx.deconvHint: Feed the recorded sweep response; parameters must match the Sweep node
afx.echoFeedbackNote: Infinite repeats, exact Audacity Echo structure
afx.speedNote: atempo keeps pitch while changing speed
afx.needsTwoAudio: Wire two audio (or video) inputs into A and B
afx.analyzeHint: Run measures the audio and prints a report
afx.mixBack: Mix voice back over ducked audio
afx.hqNote: Phase-locked vocoder (StaffPad algorithm) — slower but much cleaner than the standard modes.
afx.stemSplitHint: Hybrid Demucs 4-stem separation. First run downloads the model (~319 MB). Vocals / accompaniment cover karaoke workflows.
afx.nrProfileWired: Noise profile: from the wired noise sample.
afx.nrProfileAuto: Noise profile: auto (quietest 10% of frames). Wire a noise-only clip into noise_sample for best results.
afx.mirHint: Outputs keyframe pulses (wire into Transform/Composite track) and labels JSON with times.

scopes.wireHint: Wire a live-preview node (Color / Curves / Blur / Stylize / Chroma Key) for live scopes

optics.needsDepth: Wire a depth map (image or video) first

music.scoreFromInput: Score comes from the wired text input.
music.scoreHint: MusicXML from an LLM, MuseScore export, or by hand. Run validates and passes it downstream.
music.sfHint: Rendering with the SF2/SF3 engine (own port, no fluidsynth).
music.builtinHint: No soundfont selected — using the additive fallback synth. Drop an .sf2/.sf3 (e.g. FluidR3Mono_GM) into the Resources panel for real instruments.
music.clickFromLabels: Clicks follow the wired labels (e.g. Audio Beats & Notes).
music.clickHint: Strong beat = GM woodblock high, weak = low. Wire beat labels to click along real music.
music.noScoreYet: Paste or wire MusicXML to see the engraved score
music.chordHint: Bars split by |, chords per bar split evenly. Slash bass (C/E), qualities: m, 7, maj7, m7, dim, aug, sus4, 6, 9, m7b5…
music.channelProgramsHint: Channels map to score parts in order (part 1 = ch 0). Unlisted channels use the Instrument above; drums (ch 9) are automatic.
music.rollHint: Draw: press and drag out a note · drag moves · right edge resizes · double-click deletes · Del removes selection · Ctrl+wheel zooms
music.skippedPercussion: Percussion parts were skipped on import
music.stepHint: Step input: A-G enters a note at the cursor (nearest octave) · 7-2 picks duration · . dot · 0/space rest · Backspace steps back · Up/Down transposes (Shift = octave) · click sets the cursor
music.rollHint2: Select: drag for marquee · Ctrl+A all · Ctrl+D duplicate · velocity lane below the grid
music.notMidi: Wired input is not a MIDI payload

pictorActions.captureHint: Upload composite + one image per visible layer
pictorActions.saveToLibraryHint: Save layered PSD into the asset library
